neighbours.label: Fires on words of seductive sexual allure (seductive, seduction, sultry, sexy, alluring), on the word piece that completes them; quiet on warm or attractive words without the sexual sense.
fire: In the dim lounge, the actress wore a sultry expression for the camera.
The advert showed a seductive woman leaning against a sports car.
Fans voted him the sexiest man of the year for the third time.
His alluring glance across the dance floor made her blush.
The novel opens with a long seduction scene in a Venice hotel.
She sang the ballad in a low, sultry whisper.
The magazine cover featured a sexy model in black lace.
Critics called the dancer's performance seductive and daring.
quiet: In the dim lounge, the actress wore a tired expression for the camera.
The advert showed a smiling woman leaning against a family car.
Fans voted him the funniest man of the year for the third time.
His friendly glance across the dance floor made her relax.
The novel opens with a long breakfast scene in a Venice hotel.
She sang the ballad in a low, gentle whisper.
The magazine cover featured an elegant model in a grey suit.
Critics called the dancer's performance precise and daring.
